description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'EventBusService' which acts as a base class for services implementing any of the Hono APIs. It provides mechanisms for receiving messages via Vert.x event bus, processing requests asynchronously, tracing with OpenTracing, and handling lifecycle events like start and stop.

classes.name: EventBusService
classes.description: An abstract base class for services that handle messaging over Vert.x event bus with support for tracing, lifecycle management, and request processing.

methods.name: setTracer
methods.description: Sets the OpenTracing tracer to be used by the service.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the service, registers the request consumer, and invokes doStart.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to implement additional startup logic.

methods.name: getEventBusAddress
methods.description: Abstract method to specify the event bus address for listening to requests.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cleans up resources and invokes doStop.

methods.name: doStop
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to implement additional shutdown logic.

methods.name: registerConsumer
methods.description: Registers a handler on the event bus for incoming messages.

methods.name: processRequestMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming request messages, manages tracing context, and processes requests asynchronously.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to process a service request message.

methods.name: getTypesafeValueForField
methods.description: Retrieves a type-safe value from a JsonObject field.

methods.name: removeTypesafeValueForField
methods.description: Removes and retrieves a type-safe value from a JsonObject field.

methods.name: getRequestPayload
methods.description: Ensures the request payload contains an 'enabled' property, adding it if missing.

methods.name: finishSpanOnFutureCompletion
methods.description: Completes the tracing span upon the completion of a future representing a request processing task.
